definition: Geshe Lobsang Monlam (Tibetan: དགེ་བཤེས་བློ་བཟང་སྨོན་ལམ, Wylie: dge bshes blo bzang smon lam), born in 1976 in Ngawa eastern Tibet, is a Tibetan Buddhist scholar and programmer who uses digital technologies to preserve the Tibetan language and culture.
details: He is best known for developing Tibetan typefaces and for the multi-volume Great Monlam Tibetan Dictionary. In 2025, he received the Snow Lion Award for Human Rights from the International Campaign for Tibet. He is also working on developing a "Dalai Lama AI," a specialized language model.

explainer.lead: Lobsang Monlam is a Tibetan tech entrepreneur.

contributions.name: At the age of 17, in 1993, Lobsang Monlam fled Tibet by crossing the Himalayas to reach southern India and discovered computer science in a monastery.
He used this knowledge to design a new assembly hall for Sera Mey, which the monks needed.
In 2012, he founded and directs the Monlam Tibetan Information Technology Research Center in Dharamsala, which specializes in Tibetan language and software projects.
In 2019, advised by the 14th Dalai Lama, he founded Monlam IT and Research (OPC) Private Limited.
Since the 2000s, Monlam has been developing Tibetan typefaces; the first Monlam Tibetan font was created in 2005.

timeline.what: Born in Ngawa Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture
Lobsang Monlam was born in 1976 in Ngawa, eastern Tibet, anciently Tibetan Amdo, where he became a monk at the age of 12..
He bought his first laptop in 2002 and largely taught himself how to use the hardware and software with the help of manuals.
On May 27, 2022, the Dalai Lama inaugurated the Monlam Tibetan Dictionary, produced by the Monlam Tibetan Information Technology Research Center, at Namgyal Monastery in McLeod Ganj.

In total, Monlam has created over 37 apps related to the Tibetan language and translation; In 2023, its center launched the Monlam artificial intelligence platform, equipped with modules for machine translation, optical character recognition, speech transcription and speech synthesis..
He obtained his doctorate on November 30, 2023.
